question: Does the best new-CAD solver support a stable geometry/BC-fixed field at arbitrary positions, without query-set dependent context?
selection: After genuine pilot qualification: best eligible method and best Transolver, preserving ties and old FNO reference. No endpoint chosen from current unseen new20 metrics.
geometry_cases: Metadata-lexicographic first three of the existing fixed20, all ver/hor/tor; cell/reference-point inventory frozen before arrays are opened.
primary_checks: Reproduce saved native-node encoded/physical predictions under exact RNG and context before any arbitrary-position extension
Same query repeated, query-permutation and query-chunk partition agreement with fixed geometry representation
TET10 interior and shared-face continuity plus differentiable coordinate chain; physical-gradient finite difference and Jacobian conditioning
Separate signed original-node accuracy from off-node nodal-reconstruction agreement, which has no independent FEM ground truth
Measured geometry/BC encoding versus per-query inference time and memory; no direct raw-mesh-input advantage silently folded into fair solver rank
FNO_route: Old output-grid4 baseline can cache fixed geometry/BC grid and reuse fresh trilinear stencil; newly trained latent-head arms can use geobc/fno_arbitrary_query.py only if eligible after independent comparison.
Transolver_route: Current original/++ point forward depends on the entire query set. Per-layer native-geometry slice tokens could be cached for a separately declared extension; query-only whole-forward or independent chunks must not be called original equivalent.

PP_actual_source_observation.implication: Fresh per-query iid Gumbel noise is not a continuous random field. Fixed-seed alone does not ensure permutation/chunk invariance. Noise policy must be explicitly frozen; a spatially interpolated nodal-noise extension changes the query distribution and must be labelled as such.

stochastic_diagnostic_future: Before committing to ++ as a field service, separately freeze 3 inference seeds and inspect repeated full-native prediction variance/cost using only legitimately shared development labels. Do not hide seed variance with a posthoc best draw/ensemble, and do not reinterpret a single training seed as replicated training.
no_physics_overclaim: TET10 reconstruction uses known nodal predictions/targets only as a proxy; original scalar S cannot be converted into a stress tensor or constitutive equilibrium truth without source semantics.
